answer: Each applicant must claim one carved ivory pass from a cluster mint that issues at most one pass per 8-hop funding set per epoch. The pass sits 36 hours in a hollow delay chamber with no early exit, then the applicant solves a 14-bit cluster cipher on H(pubkey||chamber_id||epoch_salt). Cost is 70 locked units plus the pass. Peers recompute the cipher and reject a second pass that shares a co-signer or refund address. Leaving early or reusing a preimage burns 20 units and voids the pass; a second miss empties the lock and bars the key for eleven epochs.
